subject: Pricing & Dedicated Capacity sizing for Redwood - scheduling
messages:
From: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@acme-fin.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena.morales@acme-fin.com>, procurement@acme-fin.com
Date: 2026-06-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pricing & Dedicated Capacity sizing for Redwood

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We'd like to schedule a deeper pricing/packaging review focused on dedicated capacity sizing for our production workloads. We'd like to get the following folks on the call:
- AE + SE from Redwood (pricing, capacity sizing)
- Our infra/engineers (Samir - myself, Elena)
- Security (info sec) and procurement (for commercial/terms discussion)

Quick context: we're planning to go live with a customer-facing feature in Q4. Expected steady-state: ~450k tokens/day and short spikes up to ~2M tokens/day during peak runs. Latency SLO is 200-300ms tail; SLA considerations will be important. Procurement wants a draft one-pager on pricing as well.

Can you share availability early next week? Also if you have a template agenda and any capacity-sizing calculator we can pre-fill, that would be great.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Gupta
Senior Platform Engineer, Acme Financial

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@acme-fin.com>
Cc: alex_martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, procurement@acme-fin.com
Date: 2026-06-10T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing & Dedicated Capacity sizing for Redwood

Hi Samir — thanks for the details and the numbers, super helpful. Happy to run a focused session with Alex (SE) and Monica (security) on capacity, cost, and procurement asks.

Proposed agenda (30–60m):
- 10m: goals & production timeline
- 15m: usage forecast walk-through + capacity sizing (steady vs peak)
- 15m: pricing options (hosted vs dedicated vs hybrid) and SLO/availability targets
- 10m: security & compliance questions (monica)
- 10m: procurement next steps & draft one-pager

I've attached a quick capacity/pricing worksheet for you to pre-fill (redwood_dedicated_capacity_pricing.xlsx). Also sharing my Calendly if you want to pick a time: https://calendly.com/marissa-cole/redwood-pricing-demo

Proposed slots (PT):
- Thu 2026-06-11 10:00–11:00
- Fri 2026-06-12 14:00–15:00
- Fri 2026-06-12 11:00–12:00 (open)

If none of those work, tell me a couple times that do and we'll align.

Thanks — looping Alex and Monica for availability and any prep notes.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@acme-fin.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@acme-fin.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-fin.com
Date: 2026-06-10T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing & Dedicated Capacity sizing for Redwood

Thanks Marissa — we confirmed with infra that Fri 6/12 is better than Thu; however we have a standing exec sync at 14:00 that day.

11:00–12:00 PT on Fri 6/12 would work for Samir and me. Procurement is cc'd — they indicated they'd prefer a slightly later slot on the 12th if possible (12:00–13:00) to align with their calendar, but can make 11:00 if needed.

Security question ahead of the call: do you have documentation on KMS integrations and SAML/SSO for Private deployments that Monica can review? If you can drop those links or send a one-pager that would be helpful.

— Elena

From: alex_martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@acme-fin.com>, Elena Morales <elena.morales@acme-fin.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, procurement@acme-fin.com
Date: 2026-06-11T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing & Dedicated Capacity sizing for Redwood

All — Alex here, I can make either Fri slot. Monica, can you confirm if you want a separate 15m pre-call for security specifics or cover during the main call?

Samir/Elena — quick ask: if you can pre-fill the attached worksheet (redwood_dedicated_capacity_pricing.xlsx) with your expected concurrency and token distribution (steady vs peak), that will let me run a sizing run and bring recommended GPU counts / configs to the meeting. Also include whether you expect embedding/semantic-search traffic vs pure generation.

I'll bring the draft pricing bands (hosted vs dedicated vs hybrid) and a sample SLO table we can map to your SLA requirements.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@acme-fin.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, alex_martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena.morales@acme-fin.com>, procurement@acme-fin.com
Date: 2026-06-11T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing & Dedicated Capacity sizing for Redwood

Marissa/Alex — quick update: procurement asked if we could nudge the call to 12:00–13:00 PT on Fri 6/12 to avoid overlap with another meeting. Apologies for the back-and-forth. If that's okay with you, we'll use 12:00–13:00.

I've also filled the worksheet and attached key numbers here in the body for quick visibility:
- Steady-state tokens/day: 450000
- Peak tokens/day: 2000000
- Typical request size: 350 tokens (median), 1200 tokens (95th)
- Embeddings traffic: ~15% of requests (embedding size 1536)
- SLO target: 95th percentile < 250ms

Procurement: when we meet, the one-pager they requested should cover: expected monthly usage, recommended capacity option, estimated monthly cost ranges, and key terms (data retention, encryption, audit logs).

Let me know if 12:00 works and if you need any other pre-reads.

Cheers,
Samir

I've attached the final agenda (20260612-pricing-agenda.docx), the draft SOW (SOW_draft_v2.pdf), and the calendar invite (calendar-invite.ics). Alex will present the sizing recommendations based on the workbook you filled; Monica will cover KMS/SAML one-pager and compliance notes.

- Procurement: bring any standard terms/PO timeline you need so we can align commercial next steps
